metaDescription: Order custom 34 oz coffee mugs in bulk for your team or event. Large capacity, durable materials, and your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 34 oz coffee mugs offer the generous capacity needed for long meetings, busy mornings, or all-day hydration without constant refills. This oversized size is ideal for office breakrooms, construction sites, or promotional giveaways where recipients want a mug that holds a full travel cup's worth of coffee. Materials like ceramic or stainless steel keep drinks hot, and imprint methods such as screen printing or laser engraving provide crisp logo visibility. Whether you're outfitting a team or rewarding customers, these mugs make a practical, high-visibility branded item.
